gre_general.value: The chemical engineering doctorate does not require the GRE General Test.
gre_general.quote: GRE General Test scores are not required.

deadline.value: The official page prints a day and month without a year (for example 'Fall: December 1 (final)'), so no Fall 2027 date is stated.

gre_subject.value: The official programme page states no subject GRE rule.

supervisor.value: The official programme page states no rule on needing a supervisor's agreement before admission.

funding.value: The official pages checked do not state that all or most admitted students are funded.

entry_route.value: The official programme page does not say whether a bachelor's or a master's is needed.

notes: The Biotechnology Engineering doctorate is a separate School of Engineering PhD (see its GSAS page); its values are not used here. Entry route is not stated: the page says applicants 'are generally expected to have a prior degree in chemical engineering', which does not settle bachelor's vs master's. The official deadline 'Fall: December 15 (final)' has no year, so deadline is Not stated.
